figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of SWE-Bench 5G. The upper-left panel summarizes telecomspecific engineering challenges, the upper-right panel highlights benchmark assets and scale, the lower-left panel shows the evaluation loop, and the lowerright panel presents the main empirical findings.

Fig. 2. SWE-Bench 5G evaluation pipeline. In Phase 1 the agent reads the issue and NF source code, optionally augmented with a 3GPP specification excerpt, and produces a patch. In Phase 2 the patch is applied in a fresh container and validated against pass-to-pass (P2P) and fail-to-pass (F2P) tests.
